verdict.rationale: GrowthBook's public GitHub repository describes itself as "Open Source Feature Flags, Experimentation, and Product Analytics", and its docs call it "the open-source platform for feature flags and A/B testing." A community comparison independently says it is open source with an optional cloud SaaS, and a runtime probe self-hosted the official image with no account or license. Missing for 10: the specific license name and terms, and clarity on whether paid-tier features are also under the open license.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
